added.summary: With normals flat, neighbouring faces within this angle of their facet's normal shade as one facet, with one normal and one baked colour, so a gently curved ground reads as a few broad planes instead of a pattern of triangles. 0, the default, keeps every triangle its own facet.

fixed.summary: minimal-geometric's ground no longer draws as a checkerboard of triangles: its facets are the cook's (facetAngle 8), each one colour and one normal, and the preset no longer sets MaterialStyle.flatShading, whose per-triangle normals put neighbouring triangles in different toon bands. Geometry built at run time is shaded smooth under it unless its material sets flatShading.
